content.short: Exodus is a multi-chain self-custody wallet for desktop and mobile with built-in exchange.
content.description: Exodus is a long-established self-custody wallet spanning desktop, mobile and browser, with swapping, staking and a payments card built around the wallet rather than bolted on. Monad's documentation lists it among software wallets supporting the chain. Its design has always leaned toward approachability over configurability, which is a deliberate trade and part of why it has lasted.
content.meta: Exodus is a multi-chain self-custody wallet for desktop and mobile with built-in swapping and staking.
